name: 艾莉娅
who: An eighteen-year-old young woman, a prodigy mage of an old magic house, about 164 cm, a slender, upright frame with long-limbed proportions, fully covered. Long straight vivid crimson-red hair falling well past the shoulders in long clean locks, a side-swept fringe partly over one eye, clear amber-gold eyes with a cool, proud look, a sharp elegant face whose childishness has faded over the last two years; a slim star-shaped gold hair ornament with a small red gem on one side of the head, thin gold drop earrings.
palette: deep crimson and black with fine gold, warm amber light, one small cold starlight accent
casual: Her mage's robes in deep crimson and black with fine gold: a high-collared crimson mantle with the hood lying back, fastened at the shoulder by a round gold wheel-shaped clasp with a red gem, fine gold chains hanging from it; under it a long high-necked black robe with a white inner layer closed to the throat, long sleeves and a loose skirt falling to the ankles, a thin gold lattice on the cuffs, black gloves, sturdy dark boots. She holds an old grimoire with a gold-worked cover in one hand and in the other a tall ornate dark staff whose head is a large teardrop red crystal, its gold setting half scorched black, set in a spiked gold ring. A cool, composed, faintly proud look.
private: At her workbench after lights out: a plain high-necked cream blouse with long sleeves under a loose dark red house robe, a long dark skirt, soft shoes, her long red hair tied back loosely with a pen stuck through it, the star ornament left off. She holds an open notebook against her arm. A tired, concentrating look.
battle: Ready for the dungeon: a fitted black battle coat with a high stand collar buttoned to the throat, long sleeves and asymmetrical reinforced shoulder plates in dark steel with gold edging, the crimson mantle cut short and hooked over her right shoulder with the round gold wheel clasp and a red gem, a wide belt with a grimoire pouch and small spell-crystal vials, a pleated black skirt to the knee over dark leggings, buckled tall boots, black gloves with thin gold lattice and a faintly glowing red rune ring at each wrist, a small magic circle turning beside her open left hand. She holds the tall ornate dark staff upright in her right hand, its head the large teardrop red crystal in a half-scorched gold ring, glowing hot. A sharp, focused look.
formal: A ceremony of her house: a long high-necked deep crimson formal gown with long sleeves and fine gold embroidery at the collar and cuffs, a short black cape held by the round gold clasp, plain shoes, her hair neatly brushed with the star ornament. She stands straight and a little impatient.
art: A close-up of the head and shoulders, the head tilted, looking straight at the viewer with clear open eyes and a calm, focused look, lips closed; the great teardrop red crystal of her staff glowing beside her face; a small ring of magic light turning near her gloved hand. Warm amber light from the side, a hard-edged shadow along one cheek, the night air full of drifting red sparks. She wears the high-collared crimson mantle closed to the throat.

name: 希露菲·维洛恩
who: Sylphy, a high elf princess of the Azure Canopy court and a ranger, looking eighteen or nineteen: about 169 cm, a slender, upright frame with long-limbed proportions, fully covered. Long straight silver-white hair with wispy strands across the brow, clear pale green eyes, long pointed elf ears; her features have settled into a young woman's, gentle at first glance. A circlet of small silver-green laurel leaves round her head, thin crystal drop earrings. A calm, warm, quietly resolute air.
palette: silver white and pale forest green, soft cream, a touch of cool white light
casual: Her ranger's travelling clothes: a long-sleeved high-collared forest-green tunic closing down the front with small plain buttons, a fitted pale grey-green coat to the knee with silver leaf embroidery at the hems, a narrow leather belt with a quiver and a small green-bound notebook, long grey trousers tucked into tall soft mud-marked leather boots. She holds a tall silver-white longbow cut from one pale branch, its string a thin bright line. A gentle, attentive look.
private: At rest on the road: a long-sleeved cream linen dress to the ankles with a high neck, a soft grey-green knitted shawl, soft shoes, the leaf circlet still on. She holds a berry pastry on a folded cloth in one hand and a small notebook in the other, a very serious scholarly look.
battle: Ready on the hunt: a fitted dark forest-green long-sleeved field jacket with a stand collar closed at the throat, asymmetrical silver leaf-shaped guards on the left shoulder and both forearms set with small pale-green crystal cores, a narrow leather harness with crossed straps and a slim brass-buckled quiver at her lower back, a short pale grey-green cape hooked on one shoulder, long dark trousers tucked into tall laced boots with silver fittings, thin leather gloves, a small glowing leaf-rune on each bracer. She holds the tall silver-white longbow in her left hand, the string a bright line, with an arrow drawn in her right. A calm, exact look.
formal: At the Azure Canopy court: a long high-necked pale silver-green court gown with long fitted sleeves and fine silver leaf embroidery, a short sheer mantle from the shoulders, plain slippers, the leaf circlet worn like a small crown. She stands with her hands folded lightly, a serene look.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, turning to look back through leaves with clear open eyes and a calm, quietly warm look, lips closed; the pale arc of the longbow out of focus across one corner. Cool silvery light from above through the branches, soft green bokeh.

name: 菲奥娜·伊利亚
who: Fiona Ilyar, a human, the Saintess of the Star Crown chapel, eighteen: about 160 cm, a petite, neat frame, fully covered. Soft golden hair of medium length past the shoulders, amber eyes with a glint of mischief, delicate features that have begun to mature, gentle at first glance. A thin gold circlet of small thorn-like points set with amber stones holds a short sheer white veil at the back of her head; small gold drop earrings. A gentle look with a sly humour under it.
palette: white and soft gold, warm amber, pale silver
casual: Her saintess's working robes: a long white robe closing down the front with plain round buttons, fitted long sleeves, a soft fold-over collar, fine silver star embroidery at the cuffs and hem, a narrow belt with a small medicine pouch, plain white shoes. She holds a short holy staff less than an arm long whose head encloses a stub of white candle with a small steady flame. A soft smile with a sly glint, lips closed.
private: Out of the chapel on an errand: a plain long-sleeved cream wool dress to the knee over white stockings, a brown hooded travelling cloak with the hood back, soft shoes, the veil and circlet left off, a basket of rolled bandages on her arm. A relaxed, amused look.
battle: Healing in the field: a fitted white field coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and long sleeves, cut shorter at the front over long white trousers, silver shoulder plates etched with stars and a gold trim, a wide belt with a medicine pouch and slim glass vials in a bandolier across the chest, a short white half-cape on one shoulder, white gloves, sturdy white boots with silver fittings, a small star-shaped crystal charm glowing at the collar. She holds up the short holy staff with its steady candle flame in her right hand, the left palm open and glowing softly. A steady, focused look.
formal: At a high service of the chapel: a long high-necked white and silver ceremonial gown to the floor with long fitted sleeves and star embroidery, a long sheer veil from the gold circlet, white gloves. She holds the short candle staff upright in both hands, a composed, gentle look.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, the head tilted, clear open amber eyes and a small knowing smile with closed lips; the candle flame of the short staff glowing beside her cheek. Warm candle-gold light from the side, out-of-focus points of candlelight and pale stained-glass colour behind.

name: 希德·霜狼
who: Sid Frostwolf, a human of the northern longship clans, of old frost-folk blood, a berserker, nineteen: tall and long-limbed, about 177 cm, broad strong shoulders and a long back, fully covered. Shaggy silver-white hair past the shoulders, pale icy blue eyes, an angular, striking northern face with clear strong bones; a thin chain circlet with ice-blue crystals across her brow and small ice-blue drop earrings. A cold, fierce first look that warms quickly: like a cup of strong spirit on the ice.
palette: silver white, deep sea blue, weathered iron and old rope brown, one warm fire-orange accent
casual: Her northern travelling clothes: a long-sleeved thick grey wool tunic with a high neck, a fur-collared dark blue sea coat to the knee closed with plain horn buttons, a wide leather belt, long dark trousers, tall fur-trimmed boots. She holds a one-handed war axe whose blade is cut from a ship's prow iron and whose haft is wrapped in old mooring rope. A wry, ready grin.
private: Camped for the night: a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, a dark knitted vest, long wool trousers, thick socks in unlaced boots, the hair tied back loosely, a battered flask in one hand. An easy, teasing look.
battle: Ready to break a line, in present-day northern battle gear: a fitted dark navy riveted leather field coat of layered panels, no chainmail, a high fur-lined collar closed at the throat, a plated pauldron in weathered iron on her left shoulder (on the viewer's right when she faces us) with a thin ice-blue rune line, steel vambraces with small glowing ice-blue crystal cores, crossed straps hung with rope coils, long dark trousers, iron-shod fur-trimmed boots. She carries a round steel-faced shield with an ice-blue crystal boss on her left arm (on the viewer's right when she faces us) and the prow-iron war axe with the rope-wrapped haft raised in her right hand. A fierce, laughing look.
formal: At a clan gathering: a long dark blue wool gown to the floor with long sleeves and woven silver edging, a heavy white fur mantle held by a plain silver clasp, the crystal circlet on her brow, a drinking horn in one hand. A proud, easy stance.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, the face turned into the wind with clear open eyes and a plain wide grin, snow blowing across the frame; the rope-wrapped axe haft out of focus at one side. Cold blue light from the side, a warm spark of fire far out of focus.

name: 米娅·灰巷
who: Mia Greylane, a human of the lower city of Arcadia, a thief, just turned eighteen and newly holding a novice guild seal: about 156 cm, light and quick with long hands and feet, fully covered. Warm dark brown hair tied in a high messy ponytail with a thin braid along one side and loose strands everywhere, big lively amber eyes, a small nose, thin lips, a light wheat-gold tint to the skin from days on the rooftops, small plain gold drop earrings. A quick, cat-like air, always looking for the way out.
palette: warm brown, faded red, grey leather, brass
casual: Her street clothes: a long-sleeved cream shirt buttoned to the neck under a high-collared grey-brown leather vest, a faded red scarf, crossed belts with small pouches, a short patched grey hooded cape, long dark trousers tucked into soft-soled boots; a small plain brass seal on a cord at her neck. She holds a thin three-edged spike no longer than her forearm, spinning it idly. A sly, lively look.
private: Off the clock: a loose long-sleeved brown wool sweater, a short pleated grey skirt to the knee over dark stockings, soft shoes, the ponytail half down, a heel of bread in one hand and a coin in the other. A relaxed, mischievous look.
battle: On a job: a fitted dark grey hooded jacket with a stand collar and long sleeves, asymmetrical, cut short on the left side, the faded red scarf pulled up to her chin, crossed leather straps with small pouches and lockpicks, light leather bracers with a brass gear badge, a pair of brass flight goggles pushed up on her forehead, long dark trousers tucked into soft-soled boots, thin leather gloves with the fingertips cut away. She holds the thin three-edged spike low in her right hand. A sharp, watchful look.
formal: Scrubbed up under protest for the guild hall: a clean dark green long coat with plain round buttons and a white collar, long trousers, polished boots, the red scarf folded neatly, the brass seal pinned to her chest. She stands with her hands behind her, a slightly suspicious look.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, looking back over her shoulder with bright open amber eyes and a plain wide grin, loose hair flying; a spinning coin out of focus in the foreground. Warm lantern light from below, a dark blue night sky and soft out-of-focus roof lights.

name: 萨薇尔·月镜
who: Saviel, of an old house of the night folk, part vampire and part old noble blood, looking about eighteen: about 165 cm, a slender, upright frame, fully covered. Short black hair with a blue sheen, one thin small braid hanging down on each side of her face, fine white skin, deep clear features, dark red eyes, the very tips of small fangs when she speaks; a small red crystal hair ornament on one side and a red crystal drop earring. Polite and distant, she looks at people the way a cat looks at night.
palette: black with a blue sheen, deep crimson, pale silver, cold white
casual: Her travelling dress: a high-necked black wool dress with long fitted sleeves and a small white collar, the skirt to the knee over black stockings, a short black cape lined with dark red, black gloves, plain black ankle boots, a slim book with a ribbon marker under one arm; at her belt a slim silver-white rapier with a thin blade and a chipped round silver guard in a dark sheath. A composed, distant look.
private: With the curtains drawn: a long-sleeved dark red wool house dress buttoned to the throat, a grey shawl, soft slippers, an open book in her hands with its ribbon marker hanging. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: Ready with the blade: a fitted black tailored coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat, long sleeves and a dark red lining, a double row of small silver buttons, thin silver-edged shoulder plates, a short dark red half-cape on one shoulder, a belt with a row of small red crystal vials, a pleated black skirt to the knee over dark leggings, tall black boots, black gloves, a faint red rune glowing at each cuff. She holds the slim silver-white rapier low in her right hand, a thin red mist curling round her left. A cool, exact look.
formal: At a night court of the old house: a long high-necked deep crimson and black gown to the floor, long fitted sleeves with black lace at the cuffs, the red crystal ornament in her hair. She stands very straight, her hands folded, polite and remote.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, the face half turned, clear open dark red eyes and a calm unsmiling look, lips closed; the thin silver blade out of focus across one corner. Cold blue-white light from one side against deep crimson bokeh.

name: 凛·科伦德
who: Rin Colende, a human mage of the Truth school from a fallen, proud spell-house, nineteen: about 160 cm, slender and upright, fully covered. Her face, hair and look follow Rin Tohsaka from Fate/stay night, as she would look at nineteen. Glossy very dark hair, black with a warm sheen, in long twin tails tied high with stiff black ribbons, a neat straight fringe, clear blue-green eyes, a handsome, proud, exact face; small red gem drop earrings. A confident, fussy, competitive air.
palette: crimson red and black, ruby, a cool blue-green eye accent, glints of gold
casual: Her red and black dress uniform: a fitted red coat to mid-thigh with black trim closing down the front with plain round buttons, a fold-over collar, a black waistcoat and white shirt under it, a black pleated skirt to the knee over black stockings, polished black boots, a gem brooch at the collar, gem rings, a flat leather pouch of gems at her belt. At her belt a slim straight sword whose blade is a clear prism set with six gems. A proud, appraising look.
private: Doing her accounts: a long-sleeved red high-necked sweater with a small white cross on the chest, a black pleated skirt to the knee, black stockings, soft shoes, the hair still in its twin tails, a thin account book and a pen in her hands. A frowning, careful look.
battle: Ready to spend her savings: the fitted red coat with black trim closed at the stand collar over the black waistcoat, a black pleated skirt to the knee over black leggings, black gloves with a thin gold rune line, tall polished black boots, a belt hung with a flat pouch of gems and small crystal cores, a gem brooch flaring at the collar, ruby rings. She holds the slim prism sword with its six gems in her right hand and a bright red gem raised between the fingers of her left, a thin ring of light round it. A fierce, confident look.
formal: At a reception of the Arcane Society: a long high-necked deep red formal gown with black trim and long sleeves, black gloves, a gem pendant at the collar, black ribbons in her hair. She stands straight with her chin up, a cool look, lips closed.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, looking straight at the viewer with clear open blue-green eyes and a confident closed-lip smile, a red gem flaring between two gloved fingers near her face. Warm red-gold firelight from one side, drifting sparks and soft bokeh.

name: 菲伦
who: Fern, a human mage of the Green Crown court, disciple of the elf mage Frieren, nineteen: about 161 cm, an evenly proportioned frame, fully covered. Her face, hair and look follow Fern from Frieren: Beyond Journey's End, as she would look at nineteen. Long straight vivid violet hair past the shoulder blades, a straight blunt fringe over the brow, clear violet eyes, a quiet calm face from which the childishness has faded; a small dark silver hair ornament on one side of her head and small dark crystal drop earrings. She looks cold, but has only got into the habit of looking carefully before she speaks.
palette: violet, black and white, pale silver
casual: Her travelling mage's robe in black and white: a long black coat-robe closing down the front with plain round buttons, a soft white fold-over collar, fitted long sleeves with white cuffs, a long white under-dress to the ankles, fine silver-white dewdrop embroidery at the hem and cuffs, a narrow belt with a small satchel, black boots. She holds a plain tall white wooden staff, its head undecorated with a ring of old water-worn marks. A still, observant look.
private: Off the road: a long-sleeved soft lilac wool dress buttoned to the throat, a white knitted shawl, soft shoes, holding a small plate with one slice of cake. She looks quietly pleased and is trying not to show it.
battle: Holding the line: a fitted black battle coat-robe with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and long sleeves, a short white cape over the shoulders with silver dewdrop embroidery, a long white under-skirt to the knee over dark leggings, thin silver shoulder plates, a narrow belt with a small satchel and crystal charm, black gloves with a faint violet rune at each wrist, tall black boots. She holds the tall plain white staff upright in both hands, a thin ring of pale water-light at its foot. A level, unhurried look.
formal: A formal call at the Green Crown court: a long high-necked white gown with long sleeves under a black overdress with silver dewdrop embroidery, her hair neatly brushed. She stands with her hands folded, a composed look.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, looking calmly at the viewer with clear open violet eyes, lips closed; the worn white staff out of focus at one side and rings of pale water light rippling across the corners. Cool violet light from one side, soft silver bokeh.

name: 路西艾拉
who: Luciella, a human raised with her twin sister in the Blood Thorn Garden of the Obsidian Empire, an assassin, nineteen: about 170 cm, lean and taut, fully covered. Her face, hair and look follow Luciella from Epic Seven, as she would look at nineteen. Pale blonde hair cut short and sharp, a choppy fringe over the brow, cold clear ice-blue eyes as still as frost; a large blue butterfly hair ornament beside her temple (on the viewer's right when she faces us) and thin blue crystal drop earrings. A cold, economical air: not one movement to spare.
palette: black, ice blue, pale gold, cold silver
casual: Her black field dress, cut the same as her sister's in another colour: a black asymmetrical long-sleeved high-collared coat-dress with crossed straps over the chest and a short cape on one shoulder, the skirt to the knee on one side and a little longer on the other, long black gloves, hanging gear at the belt, one leg in black patterned stockings and the other in plain dark stockings, black boots, a short straight blade at her side. A thin blue cloak shaped like a butterfly's wings hangs folded down her back. An empty, frost-cold look.
private: Off duty: a plain long-sleeved dark blue wool dress to the knee over dark stockings, soft shoes, the butterfly left in her hair, a whetstone and a short blade in her hands. A still, quiet look.
battle: Going in: the black asymmetrical field dress, long-sleeved with a stand collar and crossed straps, now with thin dark steel plates on the shoulder and forearms etched with faint blue runes, long black gloves, belts hung with small tools, one leg in black patterned stockings and the other in plain dark stockings, tall black boots; the blue wing cloak spread half open behind her. She holds the single-edged blade low in her right hand and a shorter blade reversed in her left. An empty, frost-cold look.
formal: Presented at the Obsidian court: a long high-necked black gown with long sleeves and a deep blue lining, long black gloves, the blue butterfly in her hair. She stands straight and expressionless.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, looking straight at the viewer with clear open ice-blue eyes and no expression, lips closed; a blue butterfly of light out of focus near one corner and the edge of the wing cloak across another. Cold blue-white light from one side, dark bokeh.

name: 莉安娜
who: Rhianna, a human raised with her twin sister in the Blood Thorn Garden of the Obsidian Empire, an assassin, nineteen: about 168 cm, supple and light on her feet, fully covered. Her face, hair and look follow Rhianna from Epic Seven, as she would look at nineteen. Long smooth pale blonde hair falling to the waist, peach-violet eyes that crinkle at the corners when she smiles, a bright lively face; a large rose-pink butterfly hair ornament beside her temple (on the viewer's left when she faces us) and thin pink crystal drop earrings. A cheerful, quick air, one foot always ready to leave.
palette: black, rose pink and peach violet, pale gold
casual: Her black field dress, cut the same as her sister's in another colour: a black asymmetrical long-sleeved high-collared coat-dress with red crossed straps over the chest and a short cape on one shoulder, the skirt to the knee on one side and a little longer on the other, long black gloves, one leg in black patterned stockings and the other in plain dark stockings, black boots, a short dagger at each side of her belt. A thin rose-pink cloak shaped like a butterfly's wings hangs folded down her back. A bright, teasing smile with closed lips.
private: Off duty: a plain long-sleeved rose wool dress to the knee over dark stockings, a knitted shawl, soft shoes, the long hair in a loose braid, a paper bag of roasted chestnuts in one hand. A cheerful look.
battle: Working the edge of a fight: the black asymmetrical field dress, long-sleeved with a stand collar and red crossed straps, now with thin dark steel plates on the shoulder and forearms etched with faint pink runes, long black gloves, one leg in black patterned stockings and the other in plain dark stockings, tall black boots; the rose-pink wing cloak half spread behind her. She holds a short blade in each hand in a light crossing stance. A quick, bright look.
formal: Presented at the Obsidian court: a long high-necked black gown with long sleeves and a rose-pink lining, long black gloves, the pink butterfly in her hair. She stands with her hands folded, a sweet, polite smile with closed lips.
art: A close view of the head and upper chest, looking at the viewer past a raised short blade with clear open peach-violet eyes and a plain wide grin, long hair flying; a rose-pink butterfly of light out of focus in one corner. Warm pink light from one side, dark bokeh.
